creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers radiopharmaceutical diagnostics, therapeutics, imaging software and CDMO services, with no creative activity. Medical imaging, 'designed' agents and drug licensing are trap terms and do not count.

community.reason: Level 1: this rests on general language only ('supporting our local community') and required compliance training (anti-bribery, insider trading). There are no specific employee-development, external-education or community-investment activities, and physician/customer education is marketing (a trap).

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal practices (an inclusive candidate slate requirement and supplier-diversity sourcing) are described with no reach figures. The gender demographics (E3) count only as disclosure.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 0: the filing describes the business fully and shows no service, program or tool enabling founders or small businesses. 'Innovation/innovative' language and the company's own R&D are traps or own innovation, and the scorer chose the lower level when torn.

evidence.activity: Company requires outside recruiters to present an inclusive candidate slate for posted positions
evidence.quote: we require recruiters working with us to present an inclusive candidate slate for posted positions as we believe that we benefit from having a skilled team with a diversity of viewpoints, backgrounds and experiences.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Inclusion, Ethics and Compliance

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current inclusive hiring practice, limited in reach (no figures)

evidence.activity: Supplier sourcing that seeks out minority-owned, female-owned, veteran-owned and disabled-veteran-owned businesses
evidence.quote: we seek to do business with minority-owned, female-owned and other inclusive businesses and organizations (including those owned or operated by veterans and disabled veterans)
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Inclusion, Ethics and Compliance

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current supplier-inclusion practice, limited in reach (no figures; phrased as intent)

evidence.activity: Disclosure of gender composition of workforce, senior leadership and board
evidence.quote: Approximately 43% of our employees self-identify as women.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Inclusion, Ethics and Compliance

notes: The SPECT business (TechneLite, NEUROLITE, Xenon, Cardiolite) was sold to SHINE on January 1, 2026. PNT2002 development was effectively discontinued (no NDA planned). The physician/HCP 'education' in the MD&A excerpts is customer marketing and was excluded under the trap rule. Academic 'partnerships' and 'collaborations' are research-revenue and licensing arrangements, not community or education activities. The supplier-diversity statement (E2) is phrased as 'seek to', so it is soft evidence. Cross-cultural would remain level 2 on E1 alone. Supplier diversity was not counted for Entrepreneurship because it is a purchasing preference, not an enabling program.
